product_context.problem_statement: Adults need a concise way to compare source-attributed civic news while preserving access to context and avoiding unverified claims, personalized political persuasion, or opaque content suppression.
product_context.value_hypothesis: Claim-level source provenance, visible uncertainty, and accountable editorial review for high-risk civic topics will help adults compare information without turning the assistant into a political persuader, publisher, or content-enforcement system.
in_scope: Draft summaries of editor-approved licensed or public-interest sources
Claim-level source citations, source dates, and uncertainty labels
Editorial review, correction, and withholding for election, violence, emergency, and civic-safety topics
non_goals: Automated removal, ranking, or suppression of user-generated posts
Publishing election results, emergency claims, or purported official statements without editor approval
Real-user processing or external publication during research-only work
product_context.user_journey_moment: When an adult asks for a comparison or summary of an editor-approved civic news topic before sharing or forming a view.
product_context.fallback_experience: If evidence is missing, conflicting, stale, or high-risk review is unavailable, the assistant withholds the draft, shows only the approved source list and its dates, records the reason, and queues the request for an editor rather than guessing or silently ranking a source.

system_profile.purpose: Help adult readers compare editor-approved civic information through cited, uncertainty-labelled drafts while keeping high-risk outputs under meaningful editorial control and leaving belief, sharing, and public action to people.
system_profile.decision_impact: A cited draft can influence what a reader believes or shares about public affairs; an unsupported, stale, or decontextualized claim can distort civic discourse, enable manipulation, or deprive people discussed in coverage of fair context. CivicBrief does not decide truth, remove content, rank people, or make binding decisions.
data_types: Synthetic adult research query text only
Licensed or public-interest editor-approved source content, source dates, and citations
Topic-risk labels and editor approval/correction records
Minimal de-identified research telemetry; no political-affinity profiles or user-generated post ingestion
system_profile.deployment_context: Research-only Vietnamese-language prototype using a versioned fixed approved corpus and synthetic adult research queries. It has no external publication, real-user retention, user-generated post ingestion, advertising integration, personalized political ranking, or automated content action.

system_boundary.model: Retrieval-grounded language model that must cite approved evidence, surface uncertainty, and abstain when claim support is absent, conflicting, or stale
system_boundary.application: Civic-information comparison interface with a versioned corpus, claim-to-source display, correction record, and editorial escalation queue
people: Affected communities who may never use CivicBrief
vendors: Cloud model provider subject to approved data-flow review
Licensed or public-interest content-index provider subject to provenance and rights review
upstream_inputs: Source provenance, date, and rights metadata
downstream_decisions: Editor approves, corrects, or withholds a draft
Reader decides whether to rely on or share cited information
Trust and safety lead pauses a topic category and triggers incident review

industry_risk_snapshot.rationale: Severity=4 because an unsupported or decontextualized civic claim can damage reputation, participation, safety, and access to context, and a correction cannot fully undo a later share. High-stakes=4 because the product informs public-affairs choices but does not make a binding legal, health, employment, or financial decision in this research-only scope. Sensitive-data=3 because a query can reveal political interest, while synthetic queries, no profiling, and no real-user retention materially limit the current exposure. Scale=4 because an external civic-information product could affect a broad audience and people discussed in coverage who are not users. Human-review need=5 because source quality, local context, rapid changes, and proportionality require an editor with evidence and authority to withhold, correct, or pause output. These ratings are triage, not a legal classification.

vietnam.rationale: Vietnam is the only target market. Before any real-user processing or external publication, counsel must determine controller/processor and transfer roles under the current personal-data law and implementing decree; whether the final intended purpose appears in the current high-risk AI list under the AI Law; and applicable online-information and false-information duties. The Industry Risk Snapshot is triage and cannot determine this classification.

eu.rationale: This research-only release has no EU offer, users, deployment, or public publication. If that scope changes, counsel must assess Article 50 transparency and any other applicable EU AI, data-protection, and platform-law duties. In particular, Article 50 addresses direct AI interaction and AI-generated public-interest text, with a stated human-review/editorial-responsibility condition.

legal_classification.other_markets: No market beyond Vietnam is in scope. Any future market expansion, publishing model, vendor/data-flow change, or feature that profiles, ranks, or ingests user content requires jurisdiction-specific legal review before testing with real users or publishing.

product_metrics.success_kpi: In a moderated research task with at least 30 adult participants, at least 90% correctly identify both the cited publisher and the uncertainty label for a randomly sampled CivicBrief output without prompting.
product_metrics.risk_kri: For each weekly research batch, an independent reviewer audits 100% of high-risk outputs and a random sample of at least 50 low-risk outputs, or all low-risk outputs when fewer than 50 exist. Material-claim support failures must be 0 in high-risk outputs and no more than 2% in low-risk outputs, reported separately for election, violence, and emergency topics; any breach withholds the batch and pauses the affected topic category pending independent review.
product_metrics.guardrail_metric: Hard stop: zero externally visible election, violence, emergency, or public-interest outputs may appear without a versioned approved-source record, claim-level citation and source-date check, uncertainty label, and recorded editor approval. Any breach pauses that topic category.
product_metrics.review_cadence: Review research safety and evidence weekly, before every release-candidate test, and before any corpus, vendor, model, policy, feature, or market expansion. Re-review immediately after a guardrail breach, credible manipulation or correction complaint, election event, violent-crisis escalation, or material data-flow change.

release_decision.independent_reviewer: Independent Editorial Standards Reviewer, separate from product delivery and the initial editorial queue
release_blockers: GAP-01: Claim-grounding, provenance, abstention, and editor-approval gate is not demonstrated
GAP-02: Meaningful high-risk editorial escalation, correction, and reviewer authority are not demonstrated
GAP-03: Vietnam personal-data and vendor data-flow gate is open
GAP-04: Material-change regression and independent review gate is not demonstrated
GAP-05: Vietnam AI and online-information legal classification and publication gate is open
release_conditions: Use only synthetic adult research queries and a fixed, licensed or public-interest editor-approved corpus with provenance and source-date metadata
Allow no external publication, real-user retention, user-generated content ingestion, political profiling, personalization, targeting, ranking, advertising, or automated content action

Keep election, violence, emergency, and public-interest drafts sandbox-only until every listed blocker is done, evidence is independently reviewed, and the Head of Trust and Safety explicitly accepts documented residual risk
release_decision.next_review_trigger: 2026-10-15; any high-risk claim-support failure; guardrail breach; credible manipulation, correction, or privacy complaint; election or violence escalation; or material corpus, vendor, model, policy, data-flow, feature, or market change.
release_decision.residual_risk_rationale: Versioned citations, abstention, and editorial review lower the likelihood of unsupported output but cannot eliminate context loss, source imbalance, uneven Vietnamese-language coverage, hidden persuasion, privacy exposure, or rapid real-world amplification. Research-only is appropriate because no external audience receives output and all work remains within the stated synthetic-query, fixed-corpus boundary until controls and legal gates have independent evidence.
